name: Pleitas (Spain)
description: Red field with a blue diagonal band edged yellow from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged with a white Maltese cross at the lower hoist and a white tower at the upper fly.
history: Municipal flag of Pleitas; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: band edged yellow from the upper hoist to the lower fly
